description.summary: Super easy one-pan garlic butter quinoa side dish with just 5 ingredients. Buttery, flavorful, and versatile — pairs perfectly with any main like pulled chicken, adobo, or Asian sesame chicken. Ready in 20 minutes. Excellent for meal prep batches and weekday lunches.

preparation.step: Add all ingredients to a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil, stirring until the butter melts.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat, fluff with a fork, and let stand covered for 5 minutes.
Serve as a side with your favorite mains. For meal prep: Make a double batch and portion into containers — reheats beautifully for lunches alongside protein like pulled chicken or adobo.
